name: accordo
description: Build custom CRMs and Customer Hubs as code. Smart CRM stays policy-governed; for CDP + CRM, Accordo is the process layer, not ingestion, identity resolution or segmentation.

interface.shortDescription: Build custom CRM and Customer Hub code
interface.longDescription: Accordo is the open-source framework coding agents use to build custom CRMs and Customer Hubs. For Smart CRM, the agent composes while deterministic policy and human approval boundaries govern named decisions. For CDP + CRM, Accordo owns the process layer, not ingestion, identity resolution or segmentation, and ships no bridge runtime. The output is reviewable code in your repository with audit and trace. Pre-release: local SQLite, and no authentication ships.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read AGENTS.md, then run `npm run crm -- app inspect --json` and tell me which parts of my commercial process this project already supports and which it does not
